## Implementation spec (SwiftUI + Apple Human Interface Guidelines)

- **Navigation entry:** register `DataExportPage` in the `NavigationStack`/`NavigationSplitView` and (if routed) map `/data-export` to it as a deep link / `NavigationDestination`.
- **Screen scaffold:** a SwiftUI `View` + a `@Observable DataExportPageModel` that consumes the KMP core repositories/use-cases (ADR-004); expose typed state plus `load()` / `refresh()` async methods. Adaptive layout for macOS (regular) and iOS (compact/regular). No business logic in the view body.
- **Panels:** lay out every panel above with SwiftUI using the **design tokens** (P2 token catalog) — no hardcoded colors/typography; materials where the web uses glass (ADR-005).
- **Live data:** if any data source is live, subscribe to the SSE stream (P1/S4) via `.task`/`AsyncSequence` tied to the view lifecycle and surface a `>2 min` staleness indicator (ADR-013).
- **3 data states:** implement `loading` / `empty` / `error` for **each** source listed above.
- **i18n:** every string via `String(localized:)` / `LocalizedStringKey` (ADR-014); keep web key names.
- **a11y:** `.accessibilityLabel`/traits on panels + charts, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, ≥ 44pt targets, light/dark + increased-contrast (ADR-015).
- **Units:** format at the display boundary with the shared **SI converters** (P1/S5) — never store/compute non-SI.
